text: My office received a resident-led petition to install a speed bump in the second east-west laneway south of Queen Street East, east of Boardwalk Drive. Residents believe this speed bump will help reduce vehicular speeds and increase the safety of everyone in the laneway.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bump in the following laneway as shown in Drawing No. 421G-3122 dated June 2018, attached to the Letter (July 4, 2018) from Councillor Mary-Margaret McMahon: Second east-west laneway south of Queen Street East, east of Boardwalk Drive
